newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel shares dive to three-year low.
newsitem.headline: Keppel shares dive to three-year low.

text.p: Singapore conglomerate Keppel Corp's shares tumbled to a three-year low of Singapore S$9.30 in early trading on Friday.
The last time the stock was as low as S$9.30 was in March 1994.
"The selling is a reaction to the economy and to the shipbuilding activities which pulled the results down," one local dealer said.
After half an hour of trade, the stock stayed down by S$0.15 at S$9.30 on 294,000 shares.
Keppel Corp last week reported its 1996 full year profits fell 4.7 percent at S$204.10 million.
Singapore announced on Thursday February non-oil domestic exports fell a worse-than-expected 7.9 percent.
Dealers said foreign funds were probably reducing their weightings on Keppel but there was no major selling.
